Mr. S.S. Yadav, learned counsel for petitioner.
2. Ms. Suniti Bhatt, learned C.S.C. for the Union of 
India/respondent no.1, through video conferencing.
3. Mr. Ajay Veer Pundir, learned counsel for respondent 
Nos.2 and 3, through video conferencing.
4. By means of this writ petition, the petitioner has 
sought a direction in the nature of certiorari quashing the 
impugned order dated 27.07.2026, passed by the 
respondent-Authority, whereby representation of the 
petitioner has been rejected.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent(s) pray for and are 
granted six weeks’ time for filing counter affidavit(s).
6. List this case on 26.10.2026; however, the 
respondents are directed not to disengage the petitioner 
from the present assignment during the pendency of the 
present writ petition.
